raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "rectangular beam dimensions",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 delegates structural dimensions to Fig. 8(a). The rectangular shape and statement that width exceeds length do not establish numerical horizontal span S, vertical height H, or aspect ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "S = 2, H = 1 in normalized units",
        "S = 4, H = 1 in normalized units",
        "S = 40 mm, H = 10 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "force at the top center",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the force 'horizontally downward', combining incompatible directions.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward: F = (0, -P)",
        "Horizontal rightward: F = (P, 0)",
        "Horizontal leftward: F = (-P, 0)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "force application around the top center",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies the top-center location but does not define the load footprint or its nodal or traction distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at the top-center node",
        "Point force represented by consistent equivalent nodal forces if the center falls between nodes",
        "Uniform traction on the centered top-edge segment x/S in [0.475, 0.525]",
        "Uniform traction on the centered top-edge segment x/S in [0.45, 0.55]"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "total applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 4.1 nor Sec. 4.1.1 gives the low-fidelity force magnitude or its normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "Total force magnitude P = 1 in normalized units",
        "Total force magnitude P = 10 in the same units",
        "Total force magnitude P = 100 in the same units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "non-design material masks",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.1.1 do not specify forced-solid or forced-void cells, including material retained at clamps or beneath the load.",
      "readings": [
        "Entire rectangle designable; no passive cells",
        "One-element-deep forced-solid strips along both clamped edges",
        "Forced-solid clamp strips plus a three-element-wide, one-element-deep solid pad centered beneath the load"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "160 prescribed volume fractions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives the count and endpoints, 160 values from 0.25 to 0.50, but not their spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "V0(k) = 0.25 + 0.25(k/159), k = 0,...,159",
        "V0(k) = 0.25 + 0.25(k/159)^2, k = 0,...,159"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "five displayed designs for each L_min in Fig. 8(b)",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 specifies five representatives per L_min in increasing volume-fraction order, but does not identify their prescribed fractions or sweep indices.",
      "readings": [
        "Select ordered sweep entries 1, 41, 81, 121, and 160 for each L_min",
        "Select ordered sweep entries 17, 49, 81, 113, and 145 for each L_min"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "volume function and accounting convention",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) leaves V(mu1, mu2, rho) undefined. It does not explicitly give the bar-overlap formula, how rho enters material usage, or how any passive cells count.",
      "readings": [
        "Gross-domain average of a + b - ab, with a = rho*mu1 and b = rho*mu2; passive solids count toward V0",
        "Gross-domain average of rho*(mu1 + mu2 - mu1*mu2); passive solids count toward V0",
        "Average of a + b - ab over designable cells only; passive solids excluded from the prescribed fraction"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 specifies base Young's modulus 1 and Poisson's ratio 0.3, but neither it nor Sec. 4.1.1 specifies plane stress versus plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or unit-thickness convention is stated for the 2D beam. At fixed total force and fixed 2D constitutive assumption, uniform thickness changes compliance normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t = 1",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "homogenized elasticity surrogate used by Eq. (31)",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1, Eq. (4), omits the polynomial degrees, coefficients, sampling resolution, and cell discretization. The stated base material does not uniquely supply these orthotropic tensors; no equivalent scalar-density law for a conventional single-material solver is given.",
      "readings": [
        "Regenerate periodic cross-cell data on a 21-by-21 parameter grid using 64-by-64 cell elements, then fit q_max = r_max = 3",
        "Regenerate periodic cross-cell data on a 41-by-41 parameter grid using 128-by-128 cell elements, then fit q_max = r_max = 5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "upper bound on bar-width variables",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) leaves L_max symbolic. The surrogate evaluation range [0,1] in Sec. 2.1 does not explicitly establish the enforced upper optimization bound.",
      "readings": [
        "L_max = 1",
        "L_max = 0.8",
        "L_max = 0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "void stiffness and singularity treatment",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Although rho is allowed in [0,1], Eqs. (31)–(33) do not specify stiffness regularization or numerical handling of void and mechanism degrees of freedom.",
      "readings": [
        "Exact void stiffness with explicit treatment of inactive and mechanism degrees of freedom",
        "Regularized tensor C_reg = (1-epsilon)*C + epsilon*C_solid, epsilon = 1e-9",
        "Regularized tensor C_reg = (1-epsilon)*C + epsilon*C_solid, epsilon = 1e-6"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "spatial filter and filtered fields",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1.1 do not specify low-fidelity spatial filtering, its kernel, or which parameter fields it acts on.",
      "readings": [
        "No spatial filter",
        "Cone-weighted sensitivity filter on rho",
        "Cone-weighted density filter on rho",
        "Spatial filtering of both bar-width fields and rho before constitutive evaluation"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "spatial regularization radius",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No macroscopic filter radius is reported. The stated L_min values bound microstructural bar-width variables in Eq. (33); they do not specify a macroscopic filter radius.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius r = 1.5 element widths",
        "Radius r = 3 element widths",
        "Radius r = 0.05H"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter treatment at domain and passive-region boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If filtering is used, the text does not specify its boundary extension, normalization, or treatment of passive cells.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the kernel at the domain boundary and renormalize; enforce passive values afterward",
        "Extend the field outside the domain as void without boundary renormalization",
        "Reflect the field across domain boundaries and enforce passive values afterward"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density projection and continuation during low-fidelity optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 does not describe any numerical projection or continuation. The contour threshold in Sec. 2.2.2 concerns subsequent geometry extraction and does not establish an optimization projection.",
      "readings": [
        "Use continuous rho directly in Eq. (31), without projection",
        "Project rho with a smooth Heaviside function using threshold 0.5 and fixed beta = 1",
        "Use threshold 0.5 and beta continuation through 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "low-fidelity optimizer and update controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1.1 give an optimization formulation but no algorithm, move limits, step sizes, or update rule for the four fields.",
      "readings": [
        "MMA with a 0.1 move limit on normalized variables",
        "MMA with a 0.02 move limit on normalized variables",
        "Sequential quadratic programming with a 0.05 trust region on normalized variables"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial fields and reuse between volume cases",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 does not specify starting values for mu1, mu2, theta, and rho, or whether successive volume cases are warm-started.",
      "readings": [
        "Independently initialize every case with uniform mu1 = mu2 = 0.5, theta = 0, and rho adjusted to satisfy V0",
        "Independently initialize with the same widths and volume but theta = pi/4",
        "Solve volumes in ascending order and initialize each case from the preceding solution"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "low-fidelity optimization termination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No iteration cap or convergence criterion is reported for Fig. 8 generation. The 300 iterations in Sec. 4.1.2 concern the later evolutionary optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop at maximum variable change below 0.01 or 200 iterations",
        "Stop at maximum variable change below 0.001 or 1000 iterations",
        "Stop after relative compliance change stays below 1e-6 for ten iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "linear equilibrium solution accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) states equilibrium but gives no low-fidelity linear solver or tolerance. Sec. 4 identifies COMSOL specifically for high-fidelity evaluation.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct factorization",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-6",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-10"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "low-fidelity structured macro mesh",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No element counts or spacings are given for Sec. 4.1.1. The qualitative coarse/intermediate/fine meshes and later free-triangular meshing do not establish the Fig. 8 low-fidelity grid.",
      "readings": [
        "100-by-50 elements over the full rectangle",
        "200-by-100 elements over the full rectangle",
        "400-by-200 elements over the full rectangle"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "macro finite-element interpolation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The low-fidelity formulation does not specify element order or numerical integration.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear four-node quadrilaterals with 2-by-2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with stabilized reduced integration",
        "Biquadratic nine-node quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "precise stiffness objective for the Fig. 8 designs",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eqs. (22) and (33) leave obj undefined, and Sec. 3.2 says only stiffness optimization. Maximum displacement is named for the later stage in Sec. 4.1.2, so the text does not establish that Fig. 8 specifically minimizes compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Minimize compliance F^T U",
        "Minimize maximum nodal displacement magnitude",
        "Minimize absolute displacement at the loaded point in the force direction"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
